free_parameters.name: upgrade_nsize
free_parameters.why: FlexPositConfig requires base_nsize <= bits <= upgrade_nsize; 2 is the minimal upgrade_nsize for the witness bits=2 with base_nsize=1

free_parameters.name: es
free_parameters.why: FlexPositConfig requires 0 <= es < base_nsize; with the witness base_nsize=1 the only valid value is 0

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the initial weights for a deterministic run
